creative_direction.name: Bathymetric Contour Plaque
creative_direction.brief: The juice read as ocean depth: a flat petrol-teal card printed with thin pale bathymetric contour lines swirling across the upper field like a sea-floor survey, one hard-edge darker depth band sinking behind the shoulders. The cutout is lifted high into the upper zone so the lower third stays a completely calm plaque band with real breathing room: tracked geometric-sans brand line, the name set wide and centred in Century Gothic capitals near band width, the eau de toilette line beneath, closed by a short pale rule floating under the stack like a survey tick. No floor, no horizon - pure line-density descent narrative against glowing blue glass.
creative_direction.material: flat matte printed card with bathymetric contour line engraving
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat matte card in deep petrol teal, thin pale ice-blue bathymetric contour lines swirling across the upper two thirds like a sea-floor survey map, one hard-edge darker teal depth band crossing behind the middle, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients beyond printed lines, no objects
